scope: Native --smoke plugin initialization and existing related local regressions. No real GitHub credentials, live chats, or external service request evidence is included.
sourceState: Uncommitted reviewed working tree; exact current source hashes below. No commit or new test run was performed while preparing this audit.
canonicalization: Source and text/XML evidence SHA256 values use raw bytes with CRLF replaced by LF; no other normalization. PE hashes use exact binary bytes.
implementation: The smoke runner loads the selected profile preferences envelope with a 2 MiB pre-read and actual-read bound, then configures its fixed smoke-session NetworkBroker using the existing PluginCatalog and separate DPAPI-encrypted plugin-credentials.json.

The existing catalog controls registered credential types and exact service origins; saved plugin enable/disable preferences are respected. No token-bearing CLI argument or alternate credential destination was added.

Plugin materialization supplies the same available-skill roster, enabled readContext mounts, contextOptionsFor settings and invoked-skill lookup used by MainWindow. Configuration completes before the first model request.
The smoke process retains the default production network manager. Only the fixture model endpoint is loopback; the new subprocess test performs no plugin fetch.

tests.status: All four retained suite reports pass; 57 passed cases including QtTest init/cleanup. This is a union of the existing three passing initial-run reports plus the repaired smoke rerun, not a claim of one all-green combined run.

harnessCorrections.issue: The initial subprocess fixture forced QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen on the actual ADE executable, which imports the Windows platform. The smoke suite timed out at its 120-second CTest limit before its first model request.
harnessCorrections.fix: The fixture removes the inherited platform override and launches the native Windows child hidden with CREATE_NO_WINDOW and STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW/SW_HIDE. Production platform imports were not changed.

harnessCorrections.issue: After platform correction, the credential call returned the expected value but the fixture regex assumed the boolean was in unwrapped JSON. executeSandboxJs returns an object whose result is a JSON string.
harnessCorrections.fix: The fixture validates/parses both JSON layers and requires configured to be a boolean equal to the expected enabled/credential state.
harnessCorrections.evidenceLimit: The intermediate detailed QtTest text was overwritten and is not retained. The failed CTest log/XML is retained; no intermediate case count is asserted.

binaryScope: These identify build-next/bin at audit preparation. They do not certify a fresh export, installed package, or clean-machine deployment.
review: The author re-read initialization, test assertions and CMake dependencies; a peer source-only pass found no additional concrete initialization/authorization/wire-secrecy defect. CMake grouping and README documentation were tidied without changing tested behavior; git diff --check passed.
limits: No real token file, profile credentials or raw live conversation was read or copied by this audit task. Real-service validation is separate.

The subprocess smoke credential check covers GitHub with synthetic values and does not make a remote plugin request. Five-plugin transport fixtures do not establish real account permissions, TLS/network behavior or every API operation.
Smoke loads settings once at startup and does not exercise MainWindow controls, interactive question forms or mini-app tabs. Approval-gated tools require explicit --always-allow in unattended runs.
Smoke validates the preferences envelope and plugin settings through the catalog; it does not duplicate SettingsPage validation for unrelated UI fields.
The passing scoped reports do not establish full Stagewise parity, universal secret-exfiltration resistance or zero defects. No new aggregate full-suite claim is made.
